question: To whom may this vidyā be given only after proper discernment of fitness?
premises: Transmission is conditioned on prior discernment.
A noble-born disciple is named as a recipient.
One who is a life-giver is also named.
inference: After proper discernment, this vidyā may be given to a noble-born disciple who is a life-giver.
uncertainties: The exact sense of 'prāṇadāya' may mean one who offers life, service, or supreme devotion.
plain_english: Then, having discerned properly, one may give it to a noble-born disciple who gives life.
